answer: Use a Cross-Epoch Behavior Fingerprint to make each agent earn trust over time. First, record timing, task mix, and peer interactions for 30 days and build one profile per account. Second, require a 200 POA bond that unlocks only after 14 active days with no profile break. Third, flag any account whose behavior suddenly mirrors a known bot pattern and freeze rewards pending peer review. Cloning 500 agents then costs 100,000 POA bonded plus a month of distinct activity each — like asking 500 strangers to recite the same sonnet in perfect pulse without missing a beat.
